structuredContent.description: A tiny simple Paused UI glyph, isolated on a perfectly uniform solid magenta #FF00FF background for later color-key removal, 16x16 pixel art. Two equal separate upright cool sky-blue rectangular bars with a clear gap between them. Balanced compact readable silhouette, clean deliberate pixel clusters, visually coherent beside a minimal blue completion check. No play triangle, no arrow, no letters, no panel, no shadow. One static icon, not a sheet.
